extension.description: LayMesh DSL and LCSS: live figure preview, configurable image export, unit-aware rulers, canvas and plot coordinates, language help and color editing.
config.language: Language for the preview, export options, color editor, completion, hover and signature documentation. `auto` follows the VS Code display language. Command titles and Settings descriptions always follow the VS Code display language.
language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language
config.executable: Path to the native LayMesh Rust executable. Empty uses the extension bundled binary.
config.preview.debounceMs: Delay after the last edit before refreshing preview, in milliseconds (0–5000). Default: 100. Set to 0 to disable debounce. Changes take effect immediately.
config.preview.renderTimeoutMs: Maximum time for one preview render (milliseconds).
capability.untrustedWorkspaces: Static language help is available; figure preview requires workspace trust.
capability.virtualWorkspaces: LayMesh uses a native executable and local resources in the extension host.
config.export.dpi: Default raster export resolution and PDF image DPI cap.
config.export.quality: Default JPEG and lossy WebP quality.
config.export.webpLossless: Use lossless WebP export by default.
config.export.pdf.imageCompression: PDF image compression: automatic, lossless, or JPEG.
config.export.pdf.jpegQuality: JPEG quality for newly encoded PDF images.
config.export.pdf.downsample: Downsample embedded PDF images to the export DPI cap.
config.export.pdf.recompressJpeg: Recompress source JPEG instead of allowing direct embedding.
config.export.pdf.autoPaletteLimit: Maximum sampled color count treated as line art.
config.export.pdf.autoFlatnessThreshold: Flat neighboring-pixel fraction treated as line art.
config.preview.jpegQuality: Preview JPEG quality, including full-resolution display images.
config.preview.cacheMb: Normalized image and browser cache budget in MiB.
config.export.pdf.alphaBackground: PDF matte color when transparency is flattened.
config.preview.webpQuality: Lossy WebP quality for images with nonopaque pixels.
config.preview.webpMethod: WebP effort (0 is fastest) for transparent preview images.
config.preview.imageThreads: Image encoding threads; 0 selects up to 2 automatically.
config.preview.processingMemoryMb: Concurrent encoding memory budget in MiB; oversized images run alone.
